title: Unix basics: files and folders
intro: Press Type it to put each command in the terminal, then press Enter to run it. Each step gets checked when it has run.

steps.text: Where am I? pwd prints the current folder.
List everything here, including hidden files, with details.
Make a folder and move into it.
Write a line into a new file with >.
Add a second line with >> (append), then show the file.

steps.cmd: cp note.txt copy.txt && mv copy.txt renamed.txt && ls -l

steps.text: Pipes: send one command's output into another. Which files in /etc mention root?
Sort and count: the most common shells in /etc/passwd.
Ask any command for help with --help. It's long, so head shows just the start.
Go back home and remove the practice folder.
